about: The reviewed Perplexity search row of the preview spending gate (plan 2026-10-30, task W1-1; owner answers of 2026-10-30: fast mode, $0.001 per search, a $1.00 daily pot, the team total raised to $17.00). The gate (packages/providers/ops/preview_budget_helper.py, PerplexityProfile) and the app's search adapter (task W2-1) must both equal this file; a price or bound change is a reviewed change to both sides and to this file. Perplexity charges per request, never per token, and reports no usage: a search reserves and is charged exactly request_usd, whatever its size, and a reply naming any field outside reply_fields halts the gate. The request carries no model member; the gate maps every request to its one row, whose model id is the name the gate's records and its /remaining answer use. Every member a request may carry is listed under request_fields; any other member is refused before anything is reserved. query is one text (a list of texts is refused: Perplexity bills a multi-query request once but merges its results). search_language_filter is a list of exactly one ISO 639-1 code; country is one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; search_after_date_filter is Perplexity's MM/DD/YYYY form.
